assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only 86-eighty-six:raiden-shuga@original-light-novels#86-raiden-shuga-character-reference-profile, the canonical CMR-4 Raiden Shuga character reference profile (version 1.2, release 86-V2-V01-V14-1.0) at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the locked original-Japanese light novels V01-V14, with Alter.1 as audited supplemental ordinary-life evidence and Alter.2 excluded. The project's corpus map, the Character Modeling Reference method and the profile's own validation report were read for method, authority order and scope only. The ledgers L01, L02 and L09, Document 04, the relationship matrix, the diagnostic index, the CMR-9 audit, the Phase-5 and Phase-8 artifacts and the Japanese EPUBs are not curated evidence on this subject, and nothing is borrowed from them. The profile's CMR-9 verdict and its HIGH, MODERATE and OPEN labels are inputs, not conclusions. No anime adaptation, V15+ volume, Alter.2 scene or other character's profile is included, and the evaluator inspected no primary source.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: The profile's phases from V01 (practical ethical center formed before the Spearhead squadron) through V14 (the stabilizer becomes a person requiring stabilization). V14 is split where the profile locates changes: grief and withdrawal after Rito's (Rito Oriya's) death (p-004 ¶414-427), political anger (p-004 ¶686-694; p-005 ¶258-281), the teacher counterexample (p-005 ¶294-366), acting command without Shin (Shinei Nouzen) (p-007 ¶55-90), correction by Theo (Theoto Rikka) and Frederica (Frederica Rosenfort) (p-007 ¶100-351), the final attack (p-008) and relief when Shin wakes (p-008 ¶558-569). V01 is split at the fight with Shin and its repair. The default is the V10-V13 baseline. V07, V09 and V11 have no diagnostic row, Alter.1 scenes are not placed by volume, and states after V14 are not established.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, including the owner calibration rulings; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The profile gives a reconstruction thesis for Raiden (Raiden Shuga): his care language is to make situations livable, turning dramatic problems into ordinary tasks. It adds seven baseline traits, each with a confidence label and counter-control, a behavioral grammar (four attention classes, a look-identify-ask or test-revise sequence, a seven-item intervention threshold, bottom-up decision style, failure and repair styles), eight emotional-state deltas and a bounded prediction protocol. It predicts Raiden's mistakes as well as his competence: political categorization under grief, overfunctioning when the regulator he relies on is absent, hiding his own need longer than he would allow Shin (Shinei Nouzen) to, and late intervention when the person disappearing into the stabilizing role is himself (V14 p-004 to p-007). A would overclaim: the set is one derived artifact that defers to L01, L02 and L09 outside it, the V14 return from categorical anger is supplied by Theo (Theoto Rikka), Frederica (Frederica Rosenfort) and the teacher counterexample rather than by an internal rule, and T14-OQ-21 stays open. C would understate an account that says what changes his response: familiarity, impaired judgment in a comrade, grief, and whether Shin is present to regulate.

Raiden's trajectory is located by volume: V01 peer conflict with Shin (Shinei Nouzen) revised after new evidence (p-011 ¶13-32), V03 survival ethic (p-009 ¶347), V04 delegated command (p-009 ¶83-88), V08 acceptance of divergent futures (p-005 ¶388-404), V13 physical interruption of Shin's godlike frame (p-007 ¶14-71). V14 is split at located points with causes: grief and withdrawal after Rito's (Rito Oriya's) death (p-004 ¶414-427), political anger (p-004 ¶686-694; p-005 ¶258-281), the teacher counterexample (p-005 ¶294-366), acting command without Shin (p-007 ¶55-90), correction by Theo (Theoto Rikka) and Frederica (Frederica Rosenfort) (p-007 ¶100-351), and relief when Shin wakes (p-008 ¶558-569). C would understate a fine-grained V14 sequence with a causal account. A is rejected: V07, V09 and V11 have no diagnostic row, V05-V06 have three, the V02 and V10-V12 phases show capacities rather than state changes, the profile names no default state, and how much of the vice-captain burden persists after V14 is only moderate confidence.

The profile gives a functional Japanese fingerprint for Raiden (Raiden Shuga): dominant 俺, お前, ～ねえ, ～すんな, ～だろ, ～じゃねえ, clipped imperatives and profanity when angry. It states rules that constrain alternatives by state: roughness is not distance (寝てろっつったろこの馬鹿 as care, 生きてんな、この馬鹿！ as relief), ethics arrive in ordinary words (死にたくねえ。それだけだ, 一人で戦おうとすんじゃねえ), anger increases heat and categorical scope (連邦, 敵, 滅びろ) rather than complexity, and vulnerability enters as a small unadorned fact. Repair has a template, V01 悪かった。その上で、だ. There are 36 would-sound-wrong constraints. For illustrative textual Japanese with peers, household and unit in sampled states, C would understate it. A is rejected: there is no frequency or distribution, exemplars are not classified by focalization as the project method requires, address terms are given only for Shin (シン), the teacher (ばあちゃん) and generic お前, so how Raiden addresses Lena (Vladilena Milizé), Frederica (Frederica Rosenfort), Kurena (Kurena Kukumila) or superiors is not established, any polite or formal register toward superiors is not modeled, and the L09 voice ledger is outside the set.

Raiden's (Raiden Shuga's) ordinary life is anchored mostly in the mainline: scavenging food with Fido and unit administration over a crossword (V01 p-007, p-008), the motorcycle courier job and mechanical interest (V02 p-006 ¶65-77, ¶347-350), cooking for Frederica (Frederica Rosenfort) (V02 p-006 ¶267-294), household cooking (V10 p-025), staff instruction and recreation (V12 p-004), remedial lessons with his former teacher (V08 p-004 ¶397-409), heavy appetite, films, comics and boredom. Four of the five Alter.1 rows add birthday, teasing, appetite and the shopping embarrassment with Frederica. The profile ties these to the care grammar, so it discriminates rest, household care, errands with Frederica and study with the teacher. That is more than a list of tastes, so C would understate it. A is rejected: there is no daily routine, sequence or frequency, named preferences beyond food and crosswords are thin, and the Alter.1 rows are supplemental and unplaced. The profile also assigns the Alter.1 mending to Shin (Shinei Nouzen), not Raiden.

Ten directed relations from Raiden (Raiden Shuga) are analyzed. Toward Shin (Shinei Nouzen) the profile gives peer-before-follower standing, the vice-captain claim (戦隊副長としての俺の権利と責任), V04 delegation, the V13 kick and 悪い。助かった, and the V14 finding that Raiden's freedom to hate depended on trusting Shin to stop harmful action. The other relations are distinguished. Frederica (Frederica Rosenfort) receives older-brother care with an age-aware boundary. Lena (Vladilena Milizé) receives apology without surrender of critique, and later he asks her to join his lessons. Theo (Theoto Rikka) reverses direction in V14. Kurena (Kurena Kukumila) gets teasing, the Alter.1 sewing prod and the V14 あとはお願い. Rito (Rito Oriya) gets concrete reassurance and then his death. The former Alba teacher is an independent pre-Shin bond. The list also covers Fido and the commanded unit. Physical interruption is confined to intimate peers under urgency. C would understate this partner-specific discrimination. A is rejected: the profile itself asks that claims about Anju (Anju Emma) stay proportionate, several relations rest on one to three rows, Federacy superiors are not profiled, and the relationship matrix and L02 are outside the set.

Raiden's (Raiden Shuga's) private states are located mainly in V14: grief withdrawal and reluctance to burden Shin (Shinei Nouzen) (p-004 ¶414-427), recognition that the coup fantasy is displaced grief that resembles the scapegoating he despises, increased self-monitoring as acting leader (p-007 ¶55-90), and narration of the weight of being the unique vice-captain to Shin, the eastern-front Reaper, lifting when Shin wakes (p-008 ¶558-569). Earlier interior evidence is limited to reflection scenes on homeland and the future (V04 p-006 ¶606-627, V05 p-004 ¶254-289, V10 p-027 ¶168-181). B would overclaim: outside V14 the profile infers interior states from conduct, it marks constant self-narration as wrong for him, and exemplars are not classified as dialogue, inner speech or focalized narration. D would understate rendered V14 recognition that is causally linked to his self-correction.

Raiden's (Raiden Shuga's) disagreement style is directness first. Physical interruption is available only in intimate peer relations under urgency (V01 fistfight, V13 kick of Shin (Shinei Nouzen)). He apologizes while keeping the critique (V01 悪かった。その上で、だ), yields to particular counterexamples rather than to calls for calm (V14 teacher counterexample, p-005 ¶294-366), and his own anger can distort premise selection (V14 coup and revenge material). Located cases include the V01 fight and repair, V03 interruption of Shin's self-disposal (p-009 ¶271-355), V05 relational friction (p-004 ¶210-251), the V13 interruption and repair, and V14 conflict with Shin, Theo (Theoto Rikka) and Frederica (Frederica Rosenfort). The response families have conditions, so C would understate them. A is rejected: face-to-face conflict with superiors or institutions is thin (V02 p-007 ¶500-520 only), and what decides whether interruption becomes physical is only partly specified.

Raiden's (Raiden Shuga's) values are restated as conduct: survival without grand justification, particularity against category, Eighty-Six pride, nonrevenge, competence serving shared survival, responsibility tracking actual control, legitimate divergent choice, and return. Argued positions are located: what actual revenge would mean and why he refuses undifferentiated punishment (V01 p-014 ¶71-90), 死にたくねえ。それだけだ (V03 p-009 ¶347), bond without synchronized futures (V08 p-005 ¶388-403), bounded responsibility in counsel to Frederica (Frederica Rosenfort) (V12 p-006 ¶220-242), and the V14 self-correction when the teacher counterexample attacks the scope of his anger (p-005 ¶294-366). The profile states how he reasons (bottom-up, tied to who lives, eats, returns or is blamed) and how it fails (grief letting a category swallow particular people). C would understate this explicit reasoning and failure mode. A is rejected: his final political judgment of the Federacy, how he weighs his own desire against role (T14-OQ-21), and novel competing-duty dilemmas outside these classes are not modeled.

The profile lists seven humor forms for Raiden (Raiden Shuga): ribbing (Shin (Shinei Nouzen) as お兄ちゃん, teasing Lena (Vladilena Milizé), roasting Kurena (Kurena Kukumila)), literal disgust, predatory combat humor (カモ撃ち), open laughter, put-upon older-brother comedy, being the target, and dry future humor (dandelion coffee). It adds the negative rule that he starts and escalates jokes rather than serving as a straight man, with located cases in V01, V02, V04, V08, V12, V14 and Alter.1. B would overclaim: the profile does not explain when he switches from teasing to seriousness or what makes a joke land or wound, beyond the V12 face-preserving care row. D would understate forms and partners analyzed across the mainline.

A dedicated canonical profile over V01-V14 with Alter.1 supplemental, with 70 routed diagnostic rows: 20 on Phase-5 locators, 50 LOCATOR_GAP rows with EPUB paragraph routes, 5 of them from Alter.1. Two rows reuse another row's route (row 70 repeats row 40; row 69 falls inside row 63). B would overclaim: this is a derived compression of a principal ensemble character across fifteen books, the narrower authorities that control conflicts (L01, L02, L09, Document 04, the matrix and the diagnostic index) are outside the set, V07, V09 and V11 have no row and V05-V06 have three, and the profile's own validation file records an earlier active-provisional state. D would understate dedicated coverage that reaches every phase the profile names with exact routes.

There are 28 mischaracterization traps, 36 would-sound-wrong constraints and a ten-row counterexample audit. The audit narrows 'practically oriented' and 'reads other people well', revises 'socially self-sufficient' (V08 teacher request, V14 correction by Theo (Theoto Rikka) and Frederica (Frederica Rosenfort)), and records V14 滅びるならそのまま滅びろ as a state violation of his own principle. Located attributions are also negative: the Alter.1 mending belongs to Shin (Shinei Nouzen), romance with Frederica is unsupported because V14 restores an age-aware boundary, and no postwar career is established. C would understate these located constraints. A is rejected: many traps are profile rules without their own locator, and limits after V14 are open.

Each diagnostic row is located by volume, XHTML file and paragraph. The trajectory is phased by volume, and V14 is split at located paragraphs from grief through relief. C would understate this. A is rejected: several phases span volumes, the profile names no default state (this record sets one), V07, V09 and V11 are unsampled, and the five Alter.1 rows are not placed by volume.

conditions: Illustrative textual Japanese only, never quotation, with 俺 and お前 as default and rough plain morphology kept in care, fear, relief and ethical statements.

State is fixed before register: anger raises heat, profanity and categorical scope without ornate rhetoric; vulnerability is a short unadorned fact; no therapy-speak or abstract philosophical diction.

Address uses only attested forms (シン, ばあちゃん, お前 or a name). No rank, honorific or polite register toward Lena (Vladilena Milizé), Federacy superiors or institutions is invented, and such exchanges are outside the claim.
No frequency claim, acoustic or anime performance, or V15+ state.
scenario_readiness.note: Evidence supports constrained illustrative output with peers, household and the unit in sampled states. Missing address and formal-register data restrict the recipients rather than blocking use.

conditions: Chronology is one named state. The default is the V10-V13 baseline: anti-heroization embodied, care broadened, Rito (Rito Oriya) alive, Shin (Shinei Nouzen) present. An earlier phase or a V14 substate is used only when explicitly selected. V14 is split at the located grief, anger, self-correction, acting-command, corrected and relief points, and nothing after V14 is used.

The interlocutor is a profiled relation in its attested register: Shin, Frederica (Frederica Rosenfort), Lena (Vladilena Milizé), Theo (Theoto Rikka), Kurena (Kurena Kukumila), Rito before his death, the former Alba teacher, Fido, or the commanded unit. Anju (Anju Emma) is kept proportionate. Transfer to a comparable younger soldier or peer is a separate, lower-confidence condition justified by the Rito, Frederica and Kurena patterns.

The situation matches a sampled class: a comrade's self-disposal or exhaustion, unit logistics or replacement command, combat support, household care, errands or study, grief, or political anger with correction available.

Output predicts Raiden's characteristic errors (categorical anger under grief, overfunctioning when Shin is absent as his regulator, hiding his own need) as well as his practical care, and treats 'wise Raiden explains everyone' as a failure.

It abstains on T14-OQ-21 (his own future), a postwar career, his final judgment of the Federacy and any romance, and it introduces no institution, technology or relationship state absent from V01-V14.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named V01-V14 state, by default the V10-V13 baseline when Raiden is vice-captain beside Shin, practically caring, rough-spoken and able to interrupt Shin, before Rito's death and the V14 acting-command crisis.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Shin, Frederica, Lena, Theo, Kurena, Rito, the former Alba teacher, Fido or the commanded unit in their attested registers. A comparable younger soldier or peer is a separate, lower-confidence transfer, and Federacy superiors are excluded.
setting_constraints: Eighty-Six or Federacy military life, unit logistics, combat support, household, errands, education or grief
No postwar career, romance, formal political office or Alter.2 setting
No institution, technology or culture absent from the V01-V14 corpus

scenario_readiness.note: Bounded to sampled relations and situation classes. Settings and relations outside them are excluded rather than inferred.

conditions: Sampled ordinary classes only: cooking and provisioning, eating, crosswords, films and comics, boredom, teasing, errands and shopping with Frederica (Frederica Rosenfort), lessons with the former teacher, and birthdays.
Domestic competence is shown as practical care, not as a gendered household archetype. Sewing or mending is not attributed to Raiden.
No invented daily routine, named tastes beyond those attested, or settled civilian occupation.
scenario_readiness.note: Recurring conditioned ordinary conduct supports more than NOT_READY. The absence of routine and frequency blocks READY.

conditions: Situation classes the profile samples: revenge and collective guilt, survival against self-disposal, responsibility bounded by control, divergent futures, and private anger spoken from a leadership position.
Reasoning stays concrete and bottom-up, tied to particular people and consequences, and a particular counterexample can move him.
Under grief and with Shin (Shinei Nouzen), his usual regulator, absent, the model must allow the category to swallow particular people and correction to come from others.
No final political judgment of the Federacy and no novel competing-duty weighing outside these classes.
scenario_readiness.note: Located argued positions and a stated failure mode support bounded ethical extrapolation.

The profile supplies no romantic conduct for Raiden and affirmatively rejects the readings available: Frederica's (Frederica Rosenfort's) V14 goddess joke is bounded by an age-aware boundary, and the later Lena (Vladilena Milizé) relation is described without flirtation. This limits use; it is not a finding about the character.

conditions: Vice-captain and acting-leader command of the Spearhead or Eighty-Six unit: short, concrete, burden-aware orders, support fire, replacement command and retrieval.
In the V14 acting-command substate, private affect has unit-wide consequences, self-monitoring increases and overcontrol is a risk.
Staff instruction and study only as attested. No relation with Federacy superiors, staff planning outside sampled operations, or postwar career is modeled.
scenario_readiness.note: Sampled command and combat-support conduct, including the V14 failure and recovery, supports bounded professional extrapolation.

known_limits.statement: The source boundary is locked original-Japanese V01-V14 with Alter.1 supplemental and Alter.2 excluded. T14-OQ-21 (what Raiden wants for himself) stays open: civilian work, mechanical interest, education, cooking and the dandelion-coffee promise are capacities and fragments, not a vocation. His final political judgment of the Federacy, further processing of Rito's (Rito Oriya's) death and his postwar relation to Eighty-Six identity are also open.

The V14 categorical anger (滅びるならそのまま滅びろ) and the coup fantasy are a grief-amplified crisis state that Raiden later critiques, not settled politics. The state can be predicted under grief when Shin (Shinei Nouzen), his usual regulator, is absent, but it is not his baseline voice or doctrine.

Located attribution boundaries apply: the Alter.1 mending is Shin's (Shinei Nouzen's), not Raiden's; romance with Frederica (Frederica Rosenfort) is unsupported; and resistance to the mental-interference weapon is not evidence that he lacks trauma.
The profile itself asks that claims about Raiden's relation to Anju (Anju Emma) stay proportionate because it is less individually foregrounded. No Anju-specific register or conduct is modeled.

The ledgers L01, L02 and L09, Document 04, the relationship register matrix, the diagnostic locator index, the CMR-9 audit and the Japanese EPUBs are not curated evidence on this subject. The profile defers to them in any conflict, and the evaluator inspected no primary source.

Address terms for Lena (Vladilena Milizé), Frederica, Kurena (Kurena Kukumila) and superiors, any polite or formal register toward superiors or institutions, frequency data and per-exemplar focalization classification are absent.

V07, V09 and V11 have no diagnostic row, V05-V06 have three, and the five Alter.1 rows are not placed by volume. Relations with Federacy superiors and how much of the vice-captain burden persists after V14 are not established.
There is no anime, acoustic or performed-voice evidence. Voice claims cover written Japanese only.
